## Document Version History  
| Version | Date | Change | Author |
|---------|------|--------|--------|
| 2.1 | 2026-01-15 | Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures | Compliance Head |
| 2.0 | 2025-07-01 | Annual review, updated PEP screening procedures | Compliance Head |
| 1.0 | 2024-01-01 | Initial policy | Compliance Head |

name: Chunk 26/28

raw_entities.name: Know Your Customer Policy
raw_entities.description: A compliance policy governing customer identity verification and due diligence procedures. The policy has undergone multiple revisions, with the most recent version (2.1) adding risk-based re-verification schedules and Enhanced Due Diligence procedures as of 2026-01-15.
context: Version 2.1 | 2026-01-15 | Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures
Version 2.0 | 2025-07-01 | Annual review, updated PEP screening procedures

raw_entities.name: Risk-Based Re-Verification Schedule
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to conduct periodic re-verification of customer identity and information based on assessed risk levels. This provision was introduced in policy version 2.1 effective 2026-01-15.
context: Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Procedures
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to perform enhanced due diligence on customers identified as higher risk. This provision was added in policy version 2.1 effective 2026-01-15.
context: Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures

raw_entities.name: PEP Screening Procedures
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement to screen customers against Politically Exposed Person lists. The procedures were updated during the annual review in policy version 2.0 effective 2025-07-01.
context: Annual review, updated PEP screening procedures

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for authoring, maintaining, and updating the Know Your Customer Policy. The Compliance Head has authored all three versions of the policy since its inception in 2024.
context: 2.1 | 2026-01-15 | Added risk-based re-verification schedule, EDD procedures | Compliance Head
